title: ponytail stops on shiv's computer too, not only in the cloud
why: Incident (shiv's bridge session "Ponytail plugin setup audit", Nov 1 16:34 CST, via coordinator): ponytail 4.10.0 is still active on his computer although enabledPlugins sets it false; cloud sessions stopped printing its banner after #951 merged (12:38 CST).
note:
Follow-up of ponytail-off-deep-dive (done, #951). Find why a false enabledPlugins entry does not stop ponytail locally: a second settings file that enables it (user, project or local scope), a plugin install scope the repo's settings do not reach, or a hook copied outside the plugin; then turn it off in its one home. Done check: a fresh local session prints no ponytail banner. Needs a session on his computer: the cloud cannot read his install scope. His bridge sessions run there, so one can read it. Needs no answer. Placed after playwright-cache-os-key (triage 5). On the page as task item 140 (Nov 1 16:57 CST): no folder of his is shared through Remote Control, so no session here can reach his computer.
Nov 1 17:56 CST: the owner removed ponytail on the PC and confirmed it gone in the desktop app (page item 140 done). Open: why the shared off setting did not stop it. Done: the owner marked page item 140 done, Nov 1 17:56 CST (ponytail is off on his PC).
